scope: visual and packaging review, not forecast or scientific validation

visual_review.contact_sheet: all 12 PNGs inspected as a contact sheet
observations: All six CSI plots show four labeled experiments and six lead times.
All six maps show RN1, four experiments and three signed difference panels with colorbars.
Some CSI series and markers overlap, especially where values are close; use the full score table for exact values.
Each CSI threshold uses its own y-axis range, as labeled; visual heights across plots should not be compared directly.
Map thumbnails are too small to read comfortably; open full-size images. Map colors use bins and the difference scale is symmetric logarithmic, so color distance is nonlinear.
Dense point symbols visually merge, although the maps display paired points and do not interpolate.
The caption distinguishes the frozen bilinear WRF-to-RN1 mapping from the lack of additional interpolation between displayed evaluation points.

caption_revision.reason: clarify frozen bilinear mapping before point display
